answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, diluted when peers disagree, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The nebula of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the umber of the next round.
